query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count!"
             FROM workspace.session_notes n
             JOIN sessions.sessions s ON s.id = n.session_id
        LEFT JOIN sessions.session_goals sg ON sg.session_id = s.id
            WHERE s.project_id = $1
              AND ($2::text IS NULL OR lower(sg.role) = lower($2))
              AND ($3::text IS NULL OR lower(sg.display_name) = lower($3))
              AND ($4::text IS NULL OR n.kind = $4)
              AND ($5::text IS NULL OR n.status = $5)
              AND ($6::text IS NULL OR n.tags @> ARRAY[$6]::text[])
              AND ($7::uuid IS NULL OR s.session_uuid = $7)
              AND ($8::text IS NULL
                   OR n.title ILIKE '%' || $8 || '%'
                   OR n.body  ILIKE '%' || $8 || '%')
